description: Implementation of the DisplayEventDispatcher class for handling display-related events, including VSync, hotplug, mode change, and frame rate overrides, within the Android graphics subsystem.

classes.name: DisplayEventDispatcher
classes.description: Handles display events such as VSync, hotplug, mode change, and frame rate overrides, using a Looper and DisplayEventReceiver.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the display event dispatcher, setting up the receiver and adding the file descriptor to the looper.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the dispatcher, removing the file descriptor from the looper.

methods.name: scheduleVsync
methods.description: Requests the next VSync signal if not already waiting for one.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects a display event into the receiver.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the display event receiver.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles events from the looper, processing pending display events and dispatching VSync signals.

methods.name: processPendingEvents
methods.description: Reads and processes all pending display events, updating VSync info and dispatching relevant events.

methods.name: getLatestVsyncEventData
methods.description: Retrieves the latest VSync event data.
